title: Indian Society for Clinical Research (ISCR)
body_markdown:
Fortrea is pleased to participate in the 20th Annual Conference of the Indian Society for Clinical Research, taking place January 21–23, 2027, at Novotel Hyderabad Convention Centre & HICC, Hyderabad. Join our clinical research team at Booth G-12 to connect, exchange insights, and explore how Fortrea is helping advance clinical development through science, technology, and operational excellence.


We look forward to engaging with clinical research professionals and industry leaders from across India and beyond to discuss opportunities to advance clinical research together.
